description: P-38L-5-LO taken on strength 19 July 1945; operated 1945-48 in Delaware Ohio and Florida then struck off charge 12/48; requested by Richard I. Bong American Legion Post 435 of Superior and ferried to Duluth 7 Dec 1948 by Don Lopez; mounted on poles at Poplar WI May 1955; removed 12/94 and restored 1995-97 by the 148th Fighter Wing Minnesota ANG over 16000 volunteer hours; loaned to American Wings Museum Blaine MN 1997-2002 while the Superior heritage centre was built; delivered to the Bong Center 25 June 2002 and displayed inside a purpose-built hangar-shaped gallery; wears the markings of Bong's own P-38J 42-103993 Marge; serial sits inside the 44-53008/44-53327 P-38L-5-LO block
museum_name: Richard I. Bong Veterans Historical Center
